summary: Full backend + frontend testing for CRMEvent Google Login (iteration 113). 16/16 pytest cases pass covering /oauth/google/config, /start, /callback (error/state/single-use/exchange fail), /link (missing cookie, wrong pw lockout, success), resolve_identity unit (all 9 branches: unverified, by sub, by email auto-link, superadmin link, conflict with/without pw, inactive, no_account, create register/invite), plus regressions (SA password login, legacy /auth/session 400, calendar callback not 404). Frontend verified: /login google-login-button, /registrati register-google-button, /invito invite-google-btn all redirect to accounts.google.com (NOT auth.emergentagent.com) with intent=login|register|invite and correct dummy client_id; /login?google_error=no_account toast shown; /login?google_link=1 GoogleLinkPrompt + password + submit visible, submit without cookie shows 410 error toast. Mobile 390px /login renders correctly.

minor.issue: Cookie g_oauth_state is set with SameSite=Lax in code (spec), but preview ingress rewrites to SameSite=None; Partitioned. Production Aruba deployment should re-verify this behavior since real Google OAuth consent requires the cookie to survive the top-level redirect from accounts.google.com back to our callback. Lax works fine for top-level nav; None+Secure is also acceptable. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: google_login.py uses samesite='lax' for g_oauth_state (correct per spec). On production Aruba verify the cookie reaches /api/oauth/google/callback after the Google round-trip (should: top-level nav from accounts.google.com back to backend domain is Lax-compatible).
g_oauth_link cookie uses samesite='none' which is required because the POST /oauth/google/link is called from the SPA with credentials; good.

resolve_identity returns conflict only when user has NO password_hash AND different google_sub+same email. Rule: if same email + different google_sub + has password_hash => 'link'. This matches spec but is a subtle re-link path; make sure Aruba logs this operation for audit (currently only 'google account linked' log — consider recording an audit event in server.py when link succeeds).

google_login.py line 60: `user.get('role') == 'superadmin'` triggers 'link' flow regardless of whether superadmin already has a google_sub matching ident['sub']. Because the google_sub match in the preceding query already returns the user before falling through, this is only reached when the current ident sub doesn't match the stored sub — correct behavior.

Callback redirects to /registrati on error only when intent=='register'; invite intent falls back to /login — consider also redirecting invite failures back to /invito?token=... for better UX (current spec allows this, not tested as a failure case).
No rate limiting on /oauth/google/start — a bot could flood db.oauth_login_states; TTL index mitigates (10min) but consider IP throttle on Aruba.

/api/oauth/google/link only increments attempts on wrong password but does NOT delete the link on 5 attempts explicitly — relies on the guard `attempts >= 5 => 410`. Correct, but once reached user must restart the Google flow (no manual reset). OK.
